Kya pata kab kaam aa jaye, hai na?
Tag karo apne ghar ke us member ko jo sab jama karta hai.

card_text: Mummy ka rule: bahar ka khana mehnga, ghar ka khana sehat. Bahar ka order karne par bhi mummy: "Maine toh dal banayi hai."
caption:
Mummy ki dal se bada koi competition nahi hai 🍲
Order aaye ya na aaye, thali toh lagegi hi.
Family group mein bhejo ye post.

card_text: Mood: saari duniya ko bol diya "kal se pakka", aur kal wahi purana main.
caption:
Aadat badalna aasan hai, bas kal se 😅
Nayi shuruaat ka wada hum roz karte hain.
Tag karo us dost ko jo roz "kal se" bolta hai.

card_text: Mood: kaam bahut hai, himmat nahi hai. Chai bana ke sochte hain ki kaam apne aap ho jayega.
caption:
Chai har problem ka temporary solution hai ☕
Kaam wahin pada rehta hai, hum chai ke saath philosophy karte hain.
Share karo us dost ke saath jo chai ka deewana hai.

card_text: Mood: sabko lagta hai main shant hoon. Andar se 14 tabs khule hain aur sab mein music chal raha hai.
caption:
Bahar se calm, andar se browser crash 🤯
Overthinking meri side hustle hai.
Tag karo us dost ko jo sab kuch soch leta hai.

card_text:
Expectation:
Aaj jaldi so jaunga.

Reality:
Raat 2 baje ek reel dekhte dekhte pata chala ki duniya ka sabse achha bhaalu nacha raha hai.
caption:
Ek reel aur, bas ek reel aur 😴
Phir wahi subah ki pachtawa.
Tag karo us dost ko jo kabhi jaldi nahi sota.

card_text:
Expectation:
Aaj plan banega aur sab aayenge.

Reality:
Group mein 40 "haan" aur ek bhi nahi pahuncha.
caption:
Plan banana aasan hai, nibhana nahi 😂
Group ke wada karne wale hamesha ghar pe hi milte hain.
Tag karo us dost ko jo plan cancel karta hai.

card_text:
Expectation:
Online order mein jo photo dikhi, wahi aayega.

Reality:
Packet kholke: "Ye toh uska chhota bhai hai."
caption:
Online shopping mein jo dikhta hai wo milta nahi 📦
Har baar ummeed, har baar dukh.
Tag karo us dost ko jo roz order karta hai.

card_text:
Hamesha time pe pahunchne wala dost ya jo late aata hai par sabko hasa deta hai?

Ek choose karo.
caption:
Dono ki apni khubiyan hain 😄
Par group trip mein kisko saath rakhoge?
Comment mein batao aur dost ko tag karo.

card_text:
Garam garam chai ya thandi cold coffee?

Dimaag ki baat mat sunna, dil se bolo.
caption:
Ye sawaal bahut purana hai, par jawab har baar alag ☕
Tumhara pick kya hai?
Tag karo us dost ko jo dusre team mein hai.

card_text:
Mummy ka gussa ya Papa ki khamoshi?

Ek toh jhelna padega.
caption:
Dono hi level pe darr lagta hai 😬
Par kaun zyada khatarnak hai?
Family group mein bhejo aur dekho kaun kya bolta hai.

card_text: Family group mein koi sawal poochho: 1 ghanta koi nahi bolta. Jaise hi "Good Night" likho, 12 replies aa jate hain.
caption:
Sawal ka jawab kisi ko nahi pata, par Good Night sabko aata hai 😂
Har family group ka yahi haal hai.
Family group mein bhejo isse.

card_text: Chacha ne group mein photo bheji. Zoom karo toh peeche padosi ka kutta bhi smile kar raha hai.
caption:
Chacha ka photography ka shauk alag hi level ka hai 📸
Sabse achhi photo hamesha galti se aati hai.
Tag karo apne chacha ko (pyaar se).

card_text: Sachcha dost woh hai jo tumhare 3 baje raat ke message ka bhi "kya hua?" likhke reply de.
caption:
Aise dost sone nahi dete par saath bhi nahi chhodte 🤝
Unki value raat ko hi pata chalti hai.
Tag karo us dost ko jo hamesha jaagta hai.

card_text: Dosti ka matlab: tum bina bataye uske ghar ghus jao aur uski mummy tumhe pehle khana khila de.
caption:
Dost ke ghar ki mummy bhi apni hi mummy hoti hai 🏠
Yahan pet bhi bharta hai aur dil bhi.
Tag karo us dost ko jiske ghar ka khana best hai.

card_text: Monday ko office jao toh sab bolte hain "weekend kaisa tha?" Jawab: "Itna jaldi kyun khatam ho gaya?"
caption:
Weekend ki speed Monday se zyada tez hoti hai 😩
Sabko wahi jawab pata hai.
Office group mein bhejo ye post.

card_text: Exam hall mein pen ne dhokha diya aur dost ne bola: "Mere paas bas ek hi hai." Wahin dosti ka test ho gaya.
caption:
Exam ke time sabse bada tension pen ka hota hai 🖊️
Isi waqt pata chalta hai kaun asli dost hai.
Tag karo us dost ko jo hamesha pen maangta hai.

card_text:
Charger lagate hi phone 100% ho jata hai.
Charger nikalte hi 3% ho jata hai.
Ye phone hai ya mood swings?
caption:
Phone ka mood mere mood se zyada badalta hai 😂
Sach bolo, tumhare saath bhi hota hai na?
Tag karo us dost ko jiska phone hamesha 3% pe rehta hai.
